paragraphs: R' Yudan son of Rav Yitzchak. See the entry Rav Yehudah son of Rav Yitzchak.[^1]

notes.text: The heading abbreviates Yudan’s personal title, rendered R'. Both father-title occurrences and the target Yehudah explicitly have Rav. Yudan and Yehudah remain distinct; the father’s or target’s full title is not transferred to the heading.
